title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 441 (Compounding of certain offences)

content.overview: An offence punishable with fine only, or with imprisonment or fine or both, may be compounded by the Tribunal or the Regional Director, as the section allocates them.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: An offence punishable with fine only, or with imprisonment or fine or both, may be compounded by the Tribunal or the Regional Director, as the section allocates them.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: An offence punishable with imprisonment only, or with imprisonment and fine, is not compoundable. Compounding is not a second compounding within three years of a like offence.
